chunks: “Indeed, the Banu Umayyah begin with vinegar at the start of the meal and conclude with salt, while we begin with salt at the start of the meal and conclude with vinegar.”

key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about beginning a meal with salt and ending with vinegar?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام contrasts the eating custom of Banu Umayyah with the practice followed by Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام. The report conveys an etiquette of beginning food with salt and ending with vinegar, while also marking a distinction in inherited practice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4258 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said:
"Indeed, the Banu Umayyah begin their meals with vinegar and end them with salt. Whereas we begin our meals with salt and end them with vinegar."
